decisions.statement: Every Anthropic account with a page is reached in turn.
Accounts are reached in the order their slugs sort in.
Two seconds pass between one account and the next.
There is no wait before the first account or after the last.
An account's credential is read off its page when that account's turn comes.
An account whose page will not be read is named with why and passed over.
An account whose subscription is withdrawn is passed over before its token is renewed.
A token is renewed before that account's usage is read.
The renewal's answer is written beside the account's page.
An account whose renewal failed is passed over rather than read.
A dead refresh over an expired access token is said once and latched.
A renewal that worked clears a latch an earlier pass set.
A read the endpoint rate-limits is tried again after each wait the backoff names.
A read still rate-limited when the backoff is spent is refused.
A throw that is no rate limit is passed straight out.
A window whose reset has passed counts as inactive.
A window whose reset is unknown counts as inactive.
A window whose reset will not read counts as inactive.
A window is triggered where either of the two windows is inactive.
A window triggered is one message of one token.
A window that was triggered is read again before the usage is written.
The moment a window was triggered is written whether or not the trigger worked.
A usage body the wire shape refuses is treated as a read that failed.
A pass over no account is refused rather than answered as a tick that is done.
The refusal for an empty fleet names the root the pass looked under.
The repository root reaches every function here as a parameter.
Every clock read and wait taken and line said and body fetched goes through a door.
The index reading and the page reader are built once and handed to each account.
Nothing here decides which account a call goes on.
Nothing here writes into a page's own body.
No secret value is written to a log here.
A renewal that throws ends the pass before the accounts after that account.
A mark that is refused is said and the account is carried on with.
The wait between accounts is the same whether the account was read or passed over.

definition: the pass that renews every account's token and reads what each has spent
